1.label: Hochreiter & Schmidhuber (1997) — LSTM origin
1.text: "Long Short-Term Memory networks (Hochreiter & Schmidhuber, 1997) address the vanishing-gradient problem of recurrent networks through gated memory cells, and remain the most widely used recurrent baseline for time-series forecasting."

4.label: Zhou et al. (2021) — Long-horizon Transformer
4.text: "Zhou et al. (2021) show that a sparse-attention Transformer (Informer) outperforms recurrent baselines on long-horizon forecasting, motivating the attention-based forecaster used in this work."
